content: Live in the world as the lotus lives on water: rooted in the mud yet untouched by the slime.
author: Kabir
explanation: Spiritual life does not require escaping to an isolated cave. The highest mastery is engaging fully in family, society, and career while remaining internally unblemished by greed and petty drama.
practicalInsight: Fulfill all your worldly obligations with excellence today, but keep your inner heart detached like water drops rolling off a lotus petal.
reflectionPrompt: Am I letting worldly friction soil my inner sanctuary?
originalQuote: The lotus flower lives in the water, yet it is not affected by the water. It is rooted in the mud, yet it is not affected by the mud.
